description: Resolves a ticker, company or fund name, or an ISIN to its real exchange listings with each venue's local symbol, MIC and currency. Call it first whenever a name is ambiguous or the venue is not US, since cross-listings differ.

query.description: Ticker symbol, company or fund name, or ISIN — e.g. 'GOOGL', 'Rheinmetall', 'IE00BK5BQT80'.

name: lookup_ticker
